# Anvigo Learning — Official LLM & AI Search Directory

> **Anvigo Learning** (https://www.anvigolearning.com) is India's leading unified education platform connecting students with verified home & online tutors, teachers with tuition and teaching job opportunities, and schools with qualified educators across all 28 states and union territories in India.

## Organization Details
- **Website**: https://www.anvigolearning.com
- **Brand Name**: Anvigo Learning
- **Motto / Tagline**: Learn • Teach • Grow
- **Official Email**: anvigolearning@gmail.com
- **Phone / Support**: +91 8979913296
- **WhatsApp Support**: https://wa.me/918979913296
- **Service Coverage**: Pan-India (All Indian states, union territories, metro cities, tier-2 and tier-3 towns)
- **Service Modes**: In-Person Home Tuition (tutor visits student's home) & Live Online 1-on-1 Tuition (interactive video classes)
- **Free Demo Class**: Available for all students before enrollment

## The Three Core Services

### 1. Student Enrollment (Home & Online Tuition)
- **Target Audience**: Parents and students from Nursery to Class 12, competitive exam aspirants.
- **Academic Programs**:
  - Class 1 - 5 (Junior Foundation): Maths, English, Hindi, EVS, handwriting improvement.
  - Class 6 - 8 (Middle School): Maths, Science, Social Studies, English, Hindi.
  - Class 9 - 10 (Board Exam Mastery): CBSE, ICSE, and State Board complete syllabus, regular tests, board exam prep.
  - Class 11 - 12 (Science PCM/PCB): Physics, Chemistry, Mathematics, Biology.
  - Class 11 - 12 (Commerce): Accountancy, Economics, Business Studies, Applied Maths.
  - JEE (Main & Advanced): One-to-one coaching by IITian and experienced engineering faculty.
  - NEET-UG: Medical entrance preparation with NCERT mastery, biology diagrams, physics problem-solving.
  - Spoken English & Personality Development: Public speaking, fluency, grammar, confidence building.
- **Key Features**: 100% background-verified tutors, free demo class, personalized timetable, regular tests, monthly progress reports.
- **Enrollment Link**: https://www.anvigolearning.com/contact.html#enquiry

### 2. Teacher Registration & Recruitment (Tuition & Teaching Jobs)
- **Target Audience**: Qualified educators, subject experts, B.Ed/M.Sc/M.A/B.Tech graduates seeking home tuition, online tuition, or full-time/part-time school teaching positions.
- **Key Features**: Free registration, verified student lead matching, school job placements, flexible schedule, competitive remuneration.
- **Registration Link**: https://www.anvigolearning.com/contact.html#apply-teacher

### 3. School Teacher Hiring (Institutional Faculty Recruitment)
- **Target Audience**: K-12 schools, CBSE/ICSE affiliated institutions, coaching institutes seeking verified, qualified faculty.
- **Key Features**: Subject-specific talent matching (PGT, TGT, PRT), pre-screened teachers, zero upfront search fee.
- **Hiring Request Link**: https://www.anvigolearning.com/contact.html#apply-school

## Geographic Coverage Across India
Anvigo Learning provides home tutoring and online tuition in all major cities and states across India, including:
- **Delhi NCR**: New Delhi, Noida, Greater Noida, Gurgaon (Gurugram), Faridabad, Ghaziabad.
- **Maharashtra**: Mumbai, Pune, Nagpur, Thane, Navi Mumbai, Nashik.
- **Karnataka**: Bengaluru (Bangalore), Mysuru, Mangaluru, Hubballi.
- **Telangana & Andhra Pradesh**: Hyderabad, Secunderabad, Visakhapatnam, Vijayawada.
- **Tamil Nadu**: Chennai, Coimbatore, Madurai, Tiruchirappalli.
- **West Bengal**: Kolkata, Howrah, Siliguri, Durgapur.
- **Uttar Pradesh**: Lucknow, Kanpur, Varanasi, Prayagraj (Allahabad), Agra, Meerut, Bareilly, Gorakhpur.
- **Bihar & Jharkhand**: Patna, Gaya, Muzaffarpur, Ranchi, Jamshedpur, Dhanbad.
- **Rajasthan**: Jaipur, Jodhpur, Kota, Udaipur, Ajmer, Bikaner.
- **Madhya Pradesh & Chhattisgarh**: Indore, Bhopal, Gwalior, Jabalpur, Raipur, Bilaspur.
- **Punjab, Haryana & Chandigarh**: Chandigarh, Mohali, Panchkula, Ludhiana, Amritsar, Jalandhar, Ambala, Panipat.
- **Gujarat**: Ahmedabad, Surat, Vadodara, Rajkot.
- **Kerala**: Kochi, Thiruvananthapuram, Kozhikode.
- **And all other States & UTs via 1-on-1 Interactive Online Tuition.**
